symptom: describe output that lost data on replay, the part of ako/mxcli#707 that #728 left open: a user role's Description and CheckSecurity were printed as `--` comments and a user role with no module roles described as `create user role X;`, which did not parse; workflow activity, event sub-process and workflow-level annotations were `-- annotation:` comments; a consumed REST header `'Bearer ' + $Token` stored only `Bearer ` and described back as that literal; image-collection describe wrote /tmp/mxcli-preview files and printed their paths.
cause: Each describer printed what its grammar had no slot for as a comment: the positional user-role form had no key for the description, check-security or manageable roles; workflows had only the standalone `annotation` statement (refused by MDL-WF04) and no attached form; the REST header grammar took an expression but the writer stores a value template, so the variable was dropped; image bytes live in the model, but describe exported them to a side file rather than into the statement.
file: mdl/grammar/domains/MDLSecurity.g4, MDLWorkflow.g4, MDLService.g4, MDLDomainModel.g4; mdl/visitor/visitor_security.go, visitor_workflow.go, visitor_rest.go, visitor_imagecollection.go; mdl/executor/cmd_security.go, cmd_security_write.go, cmd_workflows.go, cmd_workflows_write.go, cmd_rest_clients.go, cmd_imagecollections.go; mdl/backend (SetUserRoleProperties)
fix: User role properties are a ( Key: value ) list (ModuleRoles, Description, ManageAllRoles, ManageableRoles, ManageUsersWithoutRoles, CheckSecurity), the list optional; the positional form is MDL-DEPR710 with an fmt --upgrade rewrite. Workflow notes are `@annotation '…'` before an activity or event sub-process and a header `annotation '…'` clause. A REST header value is the template `'Bearer {Token}'`; the expression form is MDL-DEPR711 and now builds that template. Image describe writes `Data: '<base64>'` (Format only when the bytes do not show it), the TUI preview decodes it, and a File: path resolves script-relative.
insight: A `--` comment in describe output is a data-loss marker, not a rendering choice: every one of these was a property the grammar could not state. Grep describers for `-- ` emits of model values before assuming a describer round-trips. For the REST header the evidence that settled the template syntax was Studio Pro's own documentation (via the MCP search_mendix_knowledge_base tool): parameters are `{name}` in the path, query, header value and body.
